title: Weigh Your Own Words: Improving Hate Speech Counter Narrative Generation via Attention Regularization
reasoning: The paper evaluates and benchmarks the performance of language models in generating counter-narratives to hate speech specifically targeting religious groups, such as Muslims and Jews. It utilizes specific identity and prejudice terms related to these religions (e.g., 'islam', 'faith', 'religion', 'cult') to analyze model attention and evaluate the quality of responses to religious hatred.
